narrative: A high-stakes central bank trifecta and geopolitical risks in the Strait of Hormuz dominate the weekend tape, setting up a volatile Sydney open. The Fed's Wednesday decision anchors a week where FOMC, BoE, and BoJ meetings are likely to trigger major shifts in the carry landscape; USD/JPY closed Friday at 163.79, and any hawkish BoJ surprise would likely pressure the pair from its SMA20-above-SMA200 bullish posture. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1375 and faces downside risk as tariff rhetoric and weak Eurozone data (CESI net -43) favor the USD's +144bp OIS carry advantage. GBP/USD closed at 1.3319 and likely faces similar downside pressure at the open from the same firming Fed hike bets, with UK meeting headlines on maritime security offering only a partial offset.
